function: Learns the downlink linear precoder (mapping from channel matrix to precoding matrix) maximizing sum rate under non-linear PA distortion, steering distortion away from users (p. 5, 12).
system: Downlink mMIMO, 64 BS antennas, 1, 2 or 4 single-antenna users, narrowband, no RIS; 5 GHz carrier used only in the power estimate (p. 3, 4, 15).
method: Unsupervised (self-supervised) edge-feature GNN, 8 layers, 128 features, trained with Adam by maximizing the sum rate; retrained per IBO; SNR-input variant (p. 5, 8-9, 11, 13).
data_channel: Custom simulator: 500,000 Rayleigh training channels, 10,000 test channels; deterministic LOS ULA channels for radiation patterns; PA polynomial fitted to modified Rapp model (p. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Trained and tested at IBO -3 dB (retrained per IBO); GNN trained on the polynomial PA is also tested on the modified Rapp PA (p. 11, 13, 16).
baselines: Non-learned: MRT, ZF, ZF plus perfect DPD, Z3RO and iterative distortion-aware DAB precoders; learned: MLP and CCNN [26] (third-order PA, K=2) (p. 5-8, 12-13).
metrics: Achievable sum rate (SNIDR via Bussgang), radiation and SDR patterns, PA and DSP power consumption at fixed rate, trainable parameters, FLOPs (p. 4-5, 8, 14-16).
complexity: Table I: ~51e6 FLOPs for the GNN (M=64, K=4, d=128, L=8), 14e12 for DAB, 1000 for ZF; 164 MFLOPs per pass in the power analysis (p. 9-10, 15).
q1_support: p. 11: "The training set consists of 500 000 generated channels" - i.i.d. Rayleigh CN(0,1) and a pure LOS ULA channel from a custom simulator; no 3GPP model and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 16: "eleventh order PA model is evaluated on the modified Rapp"
q3_support: p. 8: "highest sum rate as compared to the CCNN and MLP"; p. 13: "outperforms a perfect DPD combined with ZF"
q4_support: p. 15: "164 MFLOPs are required to compute one forward pass of"
notes: Included, area 3: the learned output is the base station precoder W = f(H) (p. 5), so the function exclusion for amplifier linearization (DPD) was considered and not applied. q1 is 0: channels are i.i.d. Rayleigh and a pure LOS ULA from a custom simulator (p. 4, 11); the 3GPP reference [28] is only for the PA model. q2 rests only on the PA-model mismatch: trained on the 11th-order polynomial PA, tested on the modified Rapp PA, channel still Rayleigh (p. 16); the SNR sweep (p. 9) and retraining per IBO (p. 13) do not count, so the reviewer should confirm. q3: learned baselines MLP and CCNN [26] (earlier paper of the same authors) are compared on sum rate only for a third-order PA, M=64, K=2 (Fig. 3, p. 7-8); non-learned ZF, MRT, ZF plus DPD, DAB are compared on the 11th-order PA (Fig. 8, p. 12-13). DAB was evaluated on only 10 channel realizations (p. 12). q4: Table I gives about 51e6 FLOPs for the GNN (p. 9) while the power analysis uses 164 MFLOPs for the same M=64, K=4 (p. 15); the paper does not reconcile them. q5: the footnote on page 1 says data are available at the GitHub link.
